lee: Heads-up: SAIL (sail-7b) goes GA to Hosted today at 16:00 PT. Short ops + migration notes below.

ana: TL;DR: new route POST /v1/generate/sail, streaming + tool-calls supported, 5% canary then staged ramp. Unpinned keys get default soft rps change 11->9.

lee: Ops bullets:
- Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/sail-migration
- Canary: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 40m -> full if green (~3h)
- Alerts: pager if p50 > 150ms or 5xx > 0.6%
- Autoscaler: spike-mode off first hour

ravi: Rollback quick cmds?

ana: Rollback: `redwoodctl deploy set-backend sail --version previous --force` then `redwoodctl route update /v1/generate/sail --weight 0`. Open rollback ticket and notify #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2025-08-05T23:00:37Z — allocation sail-hosted-x:5%

ops: Client note for SDKs (paste): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/sail -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"Hi","stream":true}'`. Pinning preserves old route.

lee: Watch Console > Models > sail-7b and escalate immediately on customer errors. Ping me for quota exceptions. Thanks all :party_popper:
